title: RdfReasoningJobRequest
description: A reasoning job OpenMetadata submits to the RDF store. It is typed and bounded, and never carries files, remote URLs or code.

operation.description: REFRESH recomputes the deductions from asserted input and publishes them as a new snapshot. CHECK answers one typed question about an import closure. EXPLAIN justifies one statement.

checkKind.description: CONSISTENCY asks whether the closure has a model. SATISFIABILITY asks whether classExpression can have an instance. SUBSUMPTION asks whether every instance of classExpression is an instance of superClassExpression; a ONE_OF classExpression asks it of named individuals. ENTAILMENT asks whether the closure entails statement.

check.description: The question a CHECK asks. SATISFIABILITY takes classExpression, SUBSUMPTION takes classExpression and superClassExpression, ENTAILMENT takes statement, and CONSISTENCY takes neither.

maxJustifications.description: Most justifications to return. Each one is a minimal set of axioms and governance facts that entails the statement.

requestId.description: Idempotency key. Submitting the same ID again returns the existing job instead of starting another.

sourceRevision.description: The serving graph OpenMetadata read just before submitting. The store rejects the job when that dataset generation no longer serves.

ontologyIri.description: Root ontology of the import closure to check or explain. Required for CHECK and EXPLAIN.

ontologyDigest.description: OpenMetadata's digest of the selected ontology input, recorded with the result.

ruleBundleDigest.description: OpenMetadata's digest of rules, recorded with the result. Required for REFRESH.

rules.description: The governance rules a REFRESH applies to a fixed point. Disabled rules take no part.
